newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Few banks trade Russian MinFins as year-end nears.
newsitem.headline: Few banks trade Russian MinFins as year-end nears.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were lower than late on Tuesday but the decline was purely indicative as there were few banks left on the market ahead of year-end holidays, dealers said on Wednesday.
"It looks like all trading has already died as banks mainly have their positions closed except for those they are keeping until 1997," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Sergei Kovzharov said.
He added client orders dominated the sleepy market.
Dealers said deals were struck through brokers rather than directly in thin trading.
